description: **Which themes does this stock belong to?** Inverse of `concepts_show`: returns a security's active concepts (id, name, today's percent change). Pass `code` (preferred; `lookup` first if you only have a name) or `query` (substring over name/ticker, may match several — read each `canonical_code`); at least one. ⚠️ A concept with null `name` and `pct_change` exists but has no snapshot yet. ⚠️ `kind` returns one dimension: `concept` (hot-theme library, default), `base` (base labels), or `industry` — carry the dimension with each id. ⚠️ An empty array means no recorded membership in this dimension. Use `concept_tags` for both layers, coverage states and currently active themes.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

code.description: Canonical code, exact (e.g. SSE:600519). Preferred over `query` when resolved.

kind.description: Dimension: concept (hot-theme library, default), base (broad base labels), or industry. All use independent chain-linked equal-weight indices with base 1000. A stored theme membership alone does not establish current trading activity; use concept_tags for current status.

limit.description: Max matched securities (1-20, default 10). Caps securities, not concepts per security.

query.description: Substring over security name or ticker (e.g. 宁德时代 / 300750). May match several.

name: concepts_of
